hub.speaker: Yvlon
hub.text: Stay behind my shield arm if it goes bad. Left side. My left. I've dug graves for people who got that wrong.

text_variants.text: Dust this thick means nothing's walked here in years. Or the thing that walks here doesn't leave tracks.
Solid work back there. You'd pass for a second-string Silver-rank. That's a compliment. Take it.
